name: text-to-image-free
description: Free AI text-to-image generation. Turn text descriptions into images. No API key required. Supports multiple models via Pollinations.ai free API.

en.tagline: Generate images from text with no API key
en.summary: Text-to-image skill for the agent. It takes a text description, sends it to the Pollinations.ai free API through curl, and returns the generated image file. It needs no API key, so you can make images without setting up an image provider account.
problem: When a user asks for an image from a description, the agent needs a way to produce it. Image generation services usually require an account and an API key.
With this skill, the agent turns the request into a Pollinations.ai call and saves the result to a local file. The user gets the image back in the same conversation.
fit: Quick image generation from a text description inside an agent workflow
Trying a few variations, using `seed` to keep a style consistent
unfit: Commercial use, since the SKILL.md limits use to non-commercial purposes
Heavy or parallel image jobs, since the free API handles one request at a time
steps: The agent detects a trigger word such as "generate", "create an image", "draw" or "make a picture" and extracts the description.
It sets the parameters: width 1024, height 768, model `sana`, watermark removed, and a random seed unless the user overrides them.
It runs curl against `image.pollinations.ai` with the prompt and parameters, with a 180 second timeout.
The agent returns the image file to the user.

zh.tagline: 无需API Key的文生图工具
zh.summary: 这是一个供智能体使用的文生图技能。它把用户给出的文字描述通过 curl 发送到 Pollinations.ai 免费 API，再把生成的图片文件返回给用户。无需 API Key，不必先注册图像服务账号。
problem: 用户想根据一段描述得到图片时，智能体需要一种生成图片的办法。图像生成服务通常要求注册账号并配置 API Key。
使用这个技能后，智能体会把请求转换为对 Pollinations.ai 的调用，并把结果保存为本地文件。用户在同一个对话里就能拿到图片。
fit: 在智能体流程中，根据文字描述快速生成图片
尝试多个版本，用 `seed` 保持风格一致
unfit: 商业用途，因为 SKILL.md 限定仅限非商业用途
大量或并行的生成任务，因为免费 API 一次只处理一个请求
steps: 智能体识别「生成」「创建图片」「画」「画一张图」等触发词，并提取图片描述。
设置参数：宽 1024、高 768、模型 `sana`、去除水印，种子默认随机，用户可以覆盖这些设置。
智能体用 curl 调用 `image.pollinations.ai`，传入提示词和参数，超时时间为 180 秒。
智能体把图片文件返回给用户。
